overview.text: Her campaign says she supports lowering taxes, pro-police legislation, ending Illinois’ sanctuary state status, fair maps, and budget and ethics reforms. She sponsored a law establishing a statewide domestic violence hotline. She also sponsored a law requiring pharmacies to provide 9-8-8 suicide prevention information. She sponsored a law on long-term care joint training. She opposed the creation of a prescription drug affordability board, citing concerns about oversight. She has criticized gerrymandering.

sources.title: House narrowly advances measure aiming to control prescription drug prices
